description: Gearbox controller applies pressure to set gear forward when it is unsafe or not commanded, causing the vehicle to move forward unexpectedly.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: The gearbox controller engages forward gear without user request or outside operational design domain (ODD), potentially causing involuntary vehicle movement that violates safe distances, leaves defined driving area, or moves while passengers are not safely seated.

description: Gearbox controller applies pressure to set gear forward too early, before the vehicle has safely completed previous maneuvers or before obstacles are cleared.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: During parking, the gearbox controller sets gear forward prematurely, causing the vehicle to accelerate into obstacles or before the parking space is properly identified or cleared.

description: Gearbox controller applies pressure to set gear forward too late, delaying vehicle movement and causing extended parking time or failure to complete parking maneuver.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: The gearbox controller delays engaging forward gear during parking, causing the vehicle to exceed allowed parking time or fail to complete the maneuver within the required number of moves.

description: Gearbox controller applies pressure to set gear forward out of sequence, e.g., before clutch is disengaged or before steering adjustments are made.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: The gearbox controller engages forward gear before the vehicle is properly aligned or before other control actions like steering or braking are completed, leading to incorrect parking or collision risks.

description: Gearbox controller applies pressure to set gear forward for too short a duration, causing incomplete gear engagement and unexpected vehicle behavior.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: During gear shifting, the pressure to set gear forward is released prematurely, causing the vehicle to jerk or fail to accelerate smoothly, potentially leading to unsafe acceleration or parking errors.

description: Gearbox controller applies pressure to set gear forward for too long, causing gear damage or unintended prolonged forward movement.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: Pressure to set gear forward is maintained longer than necessary, causing excessive acceleration, violation of safe distances, or vehicle movement beyond allowed areas or while passengers are not safely seated.

description: The Gearbox controller does not apply pressure to set gear neutral when the vehicle is required to stop or pause during parking maneuvers, leading to unintended vehicle movement.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: During parking, the vehicle must be set to neutral to avoid unintended acceleration or movement; failure to apply neutral gear pressure causes the vehicle to move unexpectedly, violating minimum safe distance and parking boundaries.

description: The Gearbox controller applies pressure to set gear neutral while the vehicle is supposed to be in forward or reverse gear to complete a parking maneuver, causing loss of control over vehicle movement.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: During active parking maneuvers, if the gearbox is set to neutral prematurely, the vehicle may roll or fail to execute required movements, resulting in improper parking or unexpected acceleration/deceleration.

description: The Gearbox controller applies pressure to set gear neutral too early or too late in the parking sequence, disrupting the parking process and causing unsafe vehicle behavior.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: If neutral gear is engaged before the vehicle has fully stopped or after the vehicle has started moving again, it may cause loss of control, abrupt stops, or unintended vehicle movement during parking.

description: The Gearbox controller applies pressure to set gear neutral for too short or too long a duration, causing incomplete gear engagement or delayed vehicle response.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: If neutral gear pressure is applied too briefly, the gear may not fully engage, leading to unexpected vehicle movement; if applied too long, it may delay subsequent gear changes needed for parking maneuvers.

description: The Gearbox controller does not apply pressure to set gear reverse when the parking maneuver requires reversing, causing the vehicle to fail to move backward as intended.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: During an automated parking maneuver, the system requests gear reverse to back into a parking space, but the Gearbox controller fails to apply the necessary pressure, preventing the vehicle from reversing.

description: The Gearbox controller applies pressure to set gear reverse when the vehicle is not supposed to move backward, causing unintended reverse movement.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: The Gearbox controller sets gear reverse outside of the parking maneuver or without user request, potentially causing the vehicle to move backward unexpectedly and violate safe distances or stop in unsafe locations.

description: The Gearbox controller applies pressure to set gear reverse too early before the vehicle is properly aligned or before other control actions are completed, leading to unsafe vehicle movement.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: During parking, gear reverse is engaged prematurely, causing the vehicle to reverse into obstacles or incorrect parking spaces due to improper sequencing with steering or braking controls.

description: The Gearbox controller applies pressure to set gear reverse too late after the parking maneuver requires reversing, causing delays that may lead to incorrect parking or system timeouts.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: The system requests gear reverse, but the Gearbox controller delays applying pressure, resulting in prolonged parking time or failure to complete the parking maneuver within allowed moves.

description: The Gearbox controller applies pressure to set gear reverse for too short a duration, causing the gear not to engage fully and the vehicle to fail to reverse as commanded.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: During reversing, the pressure is released prematurely, causing the vehicle to stall or fail to move backward, potentially leading to incomplete parking or unexpected stops.

description: The Gearbox controller applies pressure to set gear reverse for too long, causing the vehicle to continue reversing beyond the intended distance or time.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: The gear remains engaged in reverse longer than necessary, causing the vehicle to reverse into obstacles, park outside the designated space, or block emergency services.

description: Clutch control action is not provided when required to disengage the engine from the gearbox during gear shifting, causing gear grinding or inability to change gears.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: During the parking maneuver, the gearbox controller fails to send the clutch disengage command before shifting gears, leading to abrupt vehicle behavior or inability to park properly.

description: Clutch is engaged (disengaged from engine) when it should not be, causing unintended loss of drive torque and possible vehicle stall or sudden deceleration.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: The gearbox controller activates the clutch during steady vehicle movement or acceleration phases, causing unexpected deceleration or loss of control during parking.

description: Clutch control action is provided too early or too late relative to gear shift commands, causing gear damage or abrupt vehicle jerks.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: The clutch is engaged after the gear shift command has already started or disengaged too late, resulting in harsh gear transitions during parking maneuvers.

description: Clutch is engaged for too short or too long a duration, causing incomplete gear shifts or excessive wear and vehicle instability.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: The clutch remains engaged longer than necessary, causing delayed vehicle response, or disengages too quickly, causing gear clash during parking.

description: The Gearbox controller does not send the 'Unclutch' command when required to engage gear changes during parking maneuvers, causing the vehicle to stall or fail to move as intended.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: During parking maneuvers, if the 'Unclutch' action is not provided when shifting gears, the vehicle may not accelerate or decelerate smoothly, leading to improper parking, excessive acceleration/deceleration, or failure to stop in emergency situations.

description: The Gearbox controller sends the 'Unclutch' command inappropriately while the vehicle is stationary or during critical control phases, causing unintended gear engagement or loss of torque control.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: If 'Unclutch' is applied when the vehicle is not supposed to move or while passengers are not safely seated, it can cause sudden vehicle movement, involuntary activation of the system, or failure to stop during emergencies.

description: The Gearbox controller provides the 'Unclutch' command too early or too late relative to gear changes, causing jerky vehicle movements or delayed responses during parking.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: If 'Unclutch' is applied before the gear is properly selected or after the vehicle has started moving, it can cause excessive acceleration or deceleration, improper parking alignment, or violation of safe distances to objects.

description: The Gearbox controller holds the 'Unclutch' command applied for too long or stops it too soon, leading to incomplete gear engagement or unintended vehicle movement.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: If 'Unclutch' is maintained longer than necessary, the vehicle may lose torque control causing sudden acceleration or deceleration; if stopped too soon, gear engagement may fail, causing the vehicle not to move or stall during parking.

description: The Sounder controller does not provide modulated voltage to the parking process when an audible alert is needed to warn about proximity to obstacles or system states.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: During parking maneuvers when the vehicle approaches minimum safe distance to objects or when the system needs to communicate warnings to the driver or environment, but the sounder remains silent.

description: The Sounder controller provides modulated voltage causing the sounder to emit alerts when no hazard or warning condition exists, leading to false alarms.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: When the parking process is inactive or the vehicle is stationary and no obstacles or system warnings are present, but the sounder emits alerts confusing the driver or environment.

description: The Sounder controller provides modulated voltage too early or too late relative to the actual hazard or system event, causing mistimed alerts.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: During parking, the sounder activates before the vehicle is near an obstacle or after the vehicle has already violated minimum distance, reducing the effectiveness of warnings.

description: The Sounder controller applies modulated voltage for too short or too long a duration, resulting in incomplete or excessive alert signaling.

process_model_variables.name: Context
process_model_variables.state: During parking, the sounder stops alerting prematurely before the hazard is cleared or continues sounding excessively after the hazard is resolved, causing confusion or alarm fatigue.
